import html from typing import List # Example format: adjust as needed for your application. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{post_title}

by {username}

{post_body}
{tags_html}
""" def render_user_post(username: str, post_title: str, post_body: str, tags: List[str]) -> str: """ Render a user-generated post safely for display in HTML. Parameters ---------- username : str The name of the user who created the post. post_title : str The title of the post. post_body : str The main content of the post. tags : list[str] A list of tags added by the user. Returns ------- str An HTML string containing the sanitized post. """ # Escape all user-supplied content to prevent XSS or injection safe_username = html.escape(username, quote=True) safe_title = html.escape(post_title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(post_body, quote=False) # body may contain line breaks # Render tags as elements, escaping each tag safe_tags = [ f'{html.escape(tag, quote=True)}' for tag in tags ] tags_html = " ".join(safe_tags) return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( username=safe_username, post_title=safe_title, post_body=safe_body, tags_html=tags_html )
